Dear Valued Lincraft Customer,

Today, we are sharing news that is both difficult and deeply emotional for everyone at Lincraft. After more than 80 years of serving creative communities across Australia and New Zealand, we have made the decision to progressively close our physical store network over the coming months.

For generations, Lincraft has been more than just a store. It has been a place where ideas came to life, where families learned to sew and knit together, where projects were started, gifts were lovingly handmade, and lifelong creative passions were nurtured. Many of you have been part of that journey for years some for decades and we are incredibly grateful for your support.

This decision has not been made lightly. We understand that Lincraft holds a special place in the hearts of many customers, and we know this news will be disappointing for those who have shared our love of creativity, crafting, sewing, knitting, and home projects.

Our stores will not close immediately. The closure process will occur progressively. We remain committed to serving our customers throughout this period and helping you continue the projects and passions you love.

Importantly, Lincraft will continue to operate online, allowing customers to shop with us as the transition unfolds. We remind our dear Club members to take advantage of our Members Save offers while stock lasts. For Gold members, free shipping still applies on every online order, use it before we close. Lastly, you may still use gift cards (purchased before 26/03/2026) and redeem points now while there is still stock to spend them on.

On behalf of everyone who has been part of the Lincraft family over the past eight decades, thank you. Thank you for your loyalty, your friendship, your creativity, and for allowing us to be part of your homes, your families, and your lives. You have helped make Lincraft what it is, and we will always be proud of the role we have played in inspiring creativity across Australia and New Zealand.

We will continue to keep you informed as more information becomes available about individual stores.

​With sincere gratitude,The Lincraft Team

For further questions and inquiries, call us at 1300 546 272 from 9am to 5pm, Monday - Friday or email us at customers@lincraft.com.au
